question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word.

She made a __courageous__ decision to quit her job.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. **coward**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"courageous"** means having or showing courage; not deterred by danger or pain; brave. (साहसी)

 
 
• **Example: **She made a courageous decision to quit her job and start her own business.
 
 
 
• **"Coward" **refers to a person who lacks the courage to do or endure dangerous or unpleasant things. (कायर)
 
 
• **Example: **He was too much of a coward to face his problems and always ran away from them.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'courageous' **is **'coward'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. **coward**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Myopic **(निकट दृष्टि): Lacking imagination, foresight, or intellectual insight.

 
 
• **Example:** His myopic views on the economy prevent him from seeing the bigger picture.
 
 
 
• **Calm **(शांत ): Not showing or feeling nervousness, anger, or other strong emotions.
 
 
• **Example: **She remained calm even in the face of the crisis.
 
 
 
• **Obstinate** (अड़ियल): Stubbornly refusing to change one's opinion or chosen course of action, despite attempts to persuade one to do so.
 
 
• **Example:** He can be very obstinate when it comes to his beliefs.
